many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
h,w=12,26
g=[[9]*w for _ in range(h)]
markers=[(0,12),(0,19),(1,4),(2,20),(3,7),(4,21),(6,3),(6,18),(8,11),(10,2),(11,14)]
# Preserve the example template in row 4, columns 12-16.

pattern=[7,7,5,7,5]
for r,c in markers:
    for j,v in enumerate(pattern): g[r][c-2+j]=v
print(json.dumps(g))
